ctx.x: He'd jump back on the ensembles with the group. I just never could find another trumpet player to play as good as Harold did. We tried out several musicians. We tried out everybody but Dizzy Gillespie and he wasn't around then, you know. So when we came to New York I decided to dis-band and not even bother because the other kid wasn't good enough for the group. So I didn't hear from Harold for quite a while and I stayed in Kelly's Stable I think for about 4 weeks and I decided to come out. I don't know where Art…

What I did - I was here practically stranded in New York except I wouldn't tell anyone. I got myself a room at the hotel, Dewey Square Hotel, and I stayed inside that hotel. I ate and slept for about 2 weeks. I called John Hammond; he got me in touch with Louise Crane - you know the Crane paper, C-r-a-n-e? I think they - stationery or something. John Hammond booked me into the Cafe Society downtown. I just slept and thought over things and meditated as to which way I was going.
